blocks.text: Yeh chapter 8 (Physical Optics and Gravitational Waves) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What does physical optics deal with, with reference to polarization?
(Polarization ke hawale se physical optics kis cheez se bahas karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polarization ke hawale se physical optics light waves ke rawaiye aur maadde ke saath un ke amal-o-radd-e-amal (interaction) se bahas karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Physical optics with reference to polarization deals with the behaviour of light waves

blocks.prompt:
2 Interference and diffraction prove the wave nature of light. Why are they not enough to show that light is transverse?
(Interference aur diffraction light ki wave nature sabit karte hain. Yeh light ka transverse hona kyun sabit nahi karte?)
blocks.explanation: Interference aur diffraction har qisam ki lehron mein hote hain, is liye sirf light ka wave hona sabit karte hain. Yeh nahi batate ke lehrein longitudinal hain ya transverse; polarization batati hai ke light transverse hai.

book_ref.quote: These phenomena, however, do not tell us whether the light waves are longitudinal or transverse.

blocks.prompt:
3 Define the plane of polarization.
(Plane of polarization ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Plane of polarization woh satah hai jis mein medium ke zarraat ki vibration ki simt aur lehar ke chalne ki simt dono hon.

book_ref.quote: The plane of polarization is the plane containing the direction of vibration

blocks.prompt:
4 Differentiate between unpolarized and polarized light.
(Unpolarized aur polarized light mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Unpolarized light har satah mein vibrate karti hai; polarized light sirf aik satah mein.

book_ref.quote: Such a light is unpolarized. On the other hand

rows: Vibration ke components tamam mumkina satahon mein.
Vibrations sirf aik satah tak mehdood.
Electric vibrations space mein be-tarteeb (random).
Electric field vector ka aik khaas rukh.
Misalein: sooraj ki roshni, incandescent bulb, mombatti, aag.
Misaal: polaroid ya polarizing sunglasses se guzri light.

blocks.prompt:
5 Can sound waves be polarized? Give a reason.
(Kya sound waves polarize ho sakti hain? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Polarization sirf transverse waves dikhati hain. Sound waves longitudinal hain: un ki vibrations chalne ki simt ke saath hoti hain, is liye unhein aik satah tak mehdood nahi kiya ja sakta.

book_ref.quote: It is the property exhibited by transverse waves only such as light waves.

blocks.prompt:
6 Define polarization of light.
(Light ki polarization ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Polarization woh amal hai jis mein light ki electric aur magnetic vibrations aik hi satah tak mehdood kar di jati hain. Saada alfaaz mein, unpolarized light ko polarized light mein badalna.

book_ref.quote: Polarization is the process by which the electric and magnetic vibrations of light waves are restricted

blocks.prompt:
7 Name three methods by which unpolarized light can be polarized.
(Teen tareeqay likhein jin se unpolarized light ko polarize kiya ja sakta hai.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Light ko polaroid sheet jaise polarizing filter se guzarna. (2) Polarizing beam splitter istemal karna. (3) Calcite aur quartz jaise optical crystals istemal karna.

book_ref.quote: An unpolarized light can be made polarized by the following methods:

blocks.prompt:
8 How does a polarizing filter polarize unpolarized light?
(Polarizing filter unpolarized light ko kaise polarize karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab unpolarized light filter se guzarti hai to sirf woh electric field vector guzarta hai jo filter ke axis ke mutawazi ho; baqi sab ruk jaate hain. Is liye nikalne wali light polarized hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: while all other vectors are blocked

blocks.prompt:
9 What is the basis of polarization?
(Polarization ki bunyad kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Light waves ke electric field vector E ka aik khaas simt mein hona polarization ki bunyad hai.

book_ref.quote: is the basis of Polarization

blocks.prompt:
10 What is linear polarization? Give an example.
(Linear polarization kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab electric field vector aik hi satah mein hilta hai to light linearly polarized hoti hai. Misaal: sunglasses jaise polarizing filter se guzri light.

book_ref.quote: light is said to be linearly polarized

blocks.prompt:
11 What is circular polarization? Distinguish its two kinds.
(Circular polarization kya hai? Is ki do qismon mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab electric field daaire mein ghoomta hai to light circularly polarized hoti hai. Clockwise ghoomna right-handed aur counterclockwise left-handed hai. Misaal: CD ya DVD se reflect hui light.

book_ref.quote: the light is said to be circularly polarized

blocks.prompt:
12 Differentiate between circular and elliptical polarization.
(Circular aur elliptical polarization mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Circular mein E daaira banata hai; elliptical mein E bezawi (ellipse) raasta banata hai.

book_ref.quote: A combination of linear and circular polarization

rows: Electric field daaire mein ghoomta hai.
Electric field vector bezawi (elliptical) raasta banata hai.
Gardish clockwise (right-handed) ya counterclockwise (left-handed).
Linear aur circular ka milaap; Ex aur Ey barabar nahi aur/ya un mein kisi angle θ ka phase farq.
Misaal: CD ya DVD se reflect hui light.
Misaal: stress plate ya waveplate se guzri light.

blocks.prompt:
13 Differentiate between linear and circular polarization.
(Linear aur circular polarization mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Linear mein E aik satah mein rehta hai; circular mein E daaire mein ghoomta hai.

book_ref.quote: When the electric field vector oscillates in a single plane

rows: Electric field vector aik satah mein hilta hai.
Electric field daaire mein ghoomta hai.
Gardish ka koi rukh nahi.
Clockwise (right-handed) ya counterclockwise (left-handed).
Misaal: polarizing sunglasses se guzri light.
Misaal: CD ya DVD se reflect hui light.

blocks.text: 8.3 Production and detection of plane polarized light

blocks.prompt:
14 Why is the light from the Sun or an incandescent bulb unpolarized?
(Sooraj ya incandescent bulb ki light unpolarized kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke is ki electrical vibrations space mein be-tarteeb (randomly) har rukh mein hoti hain; aik satah tak mehdood nahi hotin.

book_ref.quote: The light emitted by an ordinary incandescent bulb (and also by the Sun) is unpolarized

blocks.prompt:
15 Differentiate between a polarizer and an analyzer.
(Polarizer aur analyzer mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono polaroids hain; polarizer pehle aur analyzer baad mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: If a second sheet of polaroid is placed in such a way that the axes of the polaroid

rows: Pehla polaroid jis par unpolarized light parti hai.
Doosra polaroid jo polarizer ke baad rakha jata hai.
Unpolarized light ko plane polarized banata hai.
Plane polarized light pehchanta hai: ghumane se intensity badalti hai.
Tajurbe mein sakin rehta hai.
Beam ke gird ghumaya jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
16 What happens to the light emerging from the analyzer as it is rotated from the parallel position through 90°?
(Analyzer ko parallel position se 90° tak ghumane par us se nikalne wali light ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Light madham se madham hoti jati hai aur jab polarizer aur analyzer ke axes amoodi hon to ghaib ho jati hai. Mazeed ghumane par wapas aati hai aur axes phir mutawazi hon to sab se roshan hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: the light emerging out of the second polaroid gets dimmer and dimmer

blocks.prompt:
17 How does the experiment with two polaroids prove that light waves are transverse?
(Do polaroids wala tajurba kaise sabit karta hai ke light waves transverse hain?)
blocks.explanation: Do polaroids se guzarti light un ke axes amoodi hone par ghaib ho jati hai. Longitudinal lehar apni chalne ki simt mein vibrate karti hai, is liye kisi bhi rukh par ghaib na hoti. Is liye light waves transverse hain.

book_ref.quote: This experiment proves that light waves are transverse waves.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Socho: longitudinal lehar ki vibration roshni ke raaste ke saath hai, polaroid ka axis jidhar bhi ho, us vibration ka koi hissa rokta nahi. Light ka bilkul ruk jana sirf tab mumkin hai jab vibration raaste ke amoodan (transverse) ho.

blocks.prompt:
18 Is light reflected from the smooth surface of water polarized?
(Kya paani ki hamwar satah se reflect hui light polarized hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Haan, juzwi taur par. Paani ki hamwar satah se reflect hui light satah ke mutawazi juzwi (partially) polarized hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Light reflected from smooth surface of water is partially polarized parallel to the surface.

blocks.text: 8.4 Polarized light by the method of reflection

blocks.prompt:
19 Define the polarizing angle (Brewster angle).
(Polarizing angle (Brewster angle) ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Shaffaf medium par woh khaas angle of incidence jis par reflect hui light taqreeban plane polarized ho, polarizing angle θp hai. Is angle par reflected aur refracted rays aapas mein 90° par hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: The particular angle of incidence on a transparent medium when the reflected light is almost plane polarized

blocks.prompt:
20 State Brewster's law.
(Brewster's law bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Medium 1 se medium 2 mein jaane wali light ke liye: tan θp = n2/n1. Jab medium 1 hawa ho (n1 = 1) to tan θp = n, yani polarizing angle ka tangent medium 2 ke refractive index ke barabar hai.

book_ref.quote: This equation is known as Brewster's law.

blocks.prompt:
21 Show that at the polarizing angle θr = 90° − θp.
(Sabit karein ke polarizing angle par θr = 90° − θp.)
blocks.explanation: Polarizing angle par reflected aur refracted beams aapas mein qaima zaviya banati hain. Reflected ray normal se θp aur refracted ray θr banati hai, is liye θp + θr = 90°, yani θr = 90° − θp.

book_ref.quote: If the reflected beam of light is almost plane polarized

blocks.prompt:
22 Find the polarizing angle and the angle of refraction for light in air falling on a material of refractive index 1.7.
(Hawa se 1.7 refractive index wale maadde par parne wali light ka polarizing angle aur angle of refraction nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Here n is refractive index of medium on which light is incident.

blocks.prompt:
23 The Brewster angle for light from air on a transparent plastic is 58°. Find the refractive index of the plastic.
(Hawa se aik shaffaf plastic par light ka Brewster angle 58° hai. Plastic ka refractive index nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: n = tan θB = tan 58° = 1.60.

book_ref.quote: is also called the Brewster angle

blocks.prompt:
24 How did Malus show that light reflected from glass is plane polarized?
(Malus ne kaise dikhaya ke sheeshe se reflect hui light plane polarized hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1808 mein Malus ne sheeshe se (taqreeban 57° angle of incidence par) reflect hui light ko ahista ghoomte polaroid se dekha. Polaroid ki aik position par light taqreeban bujh gayi, is liye woh plane polarized hai.

book_ref.quote: This proves that the light reflected by the glass is practically plane polarized.

blocks.prompt:
25 Why does light reflected from a table top become darker when viewed through a rotated polaroid?
(Mez ki satah se reflect hui light ghoomte polaroid se dekhne par madham kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke reflect hui light juzwi (partially) plane polarized hoti hai. Polaroid ki kuch positions par us ka axis vibration ke bare rukh ke ulat hota hai, is liye kam light guzarti hai aur satah madham lagti hai.

book_ref.quote: showing that it is partially plane polarized

blocks.prompt:
26 In which direction is light reflected at the polarizing angle polarized?
(Polarizing angle par reflect hui light kis rukh mein polarized hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh plane of incidence ke amoodan polarized hoti hai; ray diagram mein in vibrations ko dots se dikhaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Reflected light is polarized perpendicular to the plane of incidence

blocks.prompt:
27 What is glare? How does polarization help in imaging and microscopy?
(Glare kya hai? Imaging aur microscopy mein polarization kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glare woh ghair-zaroori roshni hai jo dekhne mein khalal dalti hai. Polarization glare kam aur contrast behtar kar ke tasveer ka mayaar barhati hai, khaas kar microscopy aur medical imaging mein.

book_ref.quote: Polarization enhances image quality, reducing glare

blocks.prompt:
28 Give two medical uses of polarization.
(Polarization ke do tibbi (medical) istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Polarization cancer ki tashkhees, tissue imaging aur laser surgery mein istemal hoti hai, kyunke yeh mukhtalif tissues mein farq kar sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: leveraging its ability to distinguish between different tissue types

blocks.prompt:
29 How is polarization useful in astronomy?
(Astronomy mein polarization kaise mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polarization kaainati mazahir ka tajziya karne mein madad deti hai, maslan door ke sitaron ki roshni ya cosmic microwave background radiation ki polarization.

book_ref.quote: Polarization helps us to analyze cosmic phenomena

blocks.prompt:
30 What is optical activity? Name three optically active substances.
(Optical activity kya hai? Teen optically active maaddon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Optical activity kuch maaddon ki woh salahiyat hai jis se woh guzarne wali light ka plane of polarization ghuma dete hain. Misalein: quartz crystals, cinnabar (HgS), cheeni ka paani (aur insulin, collagen).

book_ref.quote: Such substances are said to be optically active.

blocks.prompt:
31 On what factors do the amount and direction of optical rotation depend?
(Optical rotation ki miqdaar aur simt kin baaton par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: (1) Maadde ki qisam. (2) Us ka concentration. (3) Maadde mein light ka tay kiya faasla. (4) Light ki wavelength.

book_ref.quote: The amount and direction of rotation depends on following factors:

blocks.prompt:
32 Why are some substances optically active?
(Kuch maadde optically active kyun hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Optical activity maadde ke molecules ki asymmetric (ghair-mutanasib), maslan helical, shakal ki wajah se hoti hai. Aise crystals ki chand millimetre motai plane of polarization ko kayi degrees ghuma deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Optical activity occurs due to the asymmetric shape of molecules

blocks.prompt:
33 How can optical activity be used to find the concentration of a sugar solution?
(Optical activity se cheeni ke solution ka concentration kaise maloom kiya ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Solution mein cheeni plane of polarization ghumati hai aur rotation ki miqdaar concentration par munhasir hai. Polarizer aur analyzer se rotation naap kar concentration maloom ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Certain organic substances, such as sugar and tartaric acid, show optical rotation

blocks.prompt:
34 Light passes through crossed polarizer and analyzer when a sugar solution is put between them. Why?
(Crossed polarizer aur analyzer ke darmiyan cheeni ka solution rakhne se light kyun guzarne lagti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cheeni ka solution plane of polarization ko θ angle ghuma deta hai, is liye woh analyzer ke axis ke amoodan nahi rehta. Analyzer ko crossed position se θ ghumane par hi light dobara rukti hai.

book_ref.quote: The analyzer thus stops the light when rotated from the vertical

blocks.prompt:
35 Polarized light of intensity 90 W m⁻² passes through an analyzer whose axis is at 37° to the polarizer's axis. Find the emerging intensity.
(90 W m⁻² intensity ki polarized light aise analyzer se guzarti hai jis ka axis polarizer ke axis se 37° par hai. Nikalne wali intensity nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Polarized light with an intensity of 75 W m⁻² passes through an analyzer

blocks.prompt:
36 Polarized light of amplitude 8 units meets an analyzer at 30° to its plane of polarization. Find the transmitted amplitude.
(8 units amplitude ki polarized light apne plane of polarization se 30° par rakhe analyzer par parti hai. Guzarne wala amplitude nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: A = A₀cos θ = 8 × cos 30° = 8 × 0.866 = 6.93 units.

book_ref.quote: Find the amplitude of the wave after passing through the analyzer?

blocks.prompt:
37 Why is a polaroid fitted on a camera used for sky photography?
(Sky photography wale camera par polaroid kyun lagaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polaroid fiza ke chhote zarraat se light ke bikharne (scattering) se bani glare aur haze kam karta hai. Zyada safed roshni rok kar contrast barhata hai aur tasveer roshan aur wazeh banti hai.

book_ref.quote: A camera which is used to photograph the clouds is fitted with a polaroid.

blocks.prompt:
38 What is photoelasticity?
(Photoelasticity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dabao (stress) wale shaffaf maadde mein se polarized light guzaar kar polarization ki tabdeeliyon (interference fringes) se stress patterns, kamzoriyan ya nuqs maloom karna photoelasticity kehlata hai. Engineering, materials science aur quality control mein istemal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: polarizers are used to analyze the stress and strain on materials

blocks.prompt:
39 What can researchers find out by stress analysis of a transparent material with polarized light?
(Polarized light se shaffaf maadde ke stress analysis se researchers kya maloom kar sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Woh maadde ke stress patterns, mumkina kamzoriyan ya nuqs, optical khasusiyaat, aur mukhtalif halaat mein us ka rawaiya maloom kar sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: determine the material's stress patterns

blocks.prompt:
40 State Malus's law.
(Malus's law bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Analyzer se guzarne ke baad plane polarized light ki intensity I, analyzer aur polarizer ke transmission axes ke darmiyan angle θ ke cosine ke square ke seedha mutanasib hai: I ∝ cos²θ, yani I = I₀cos²θ.

book_ref.quote: Malus's law states that the intensity I of plane polarized light after passing through an analyzer

blocks.prompt:
41 What is a polaroid? Give two examples of materials that act as polaroids.
(Polaroid kya hai? Polaroid ka kaam karne wale do maaddon ki misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Kuch shaffaf crystal maadde jo light ki vibrations ko sirf aik satah tak mehdood karte hain, polaroids kehlate hain; un ki crystal structure mein zyada simt-pazeeri (directionality) hoti hai. Misalein: tourmaline, calcite.

book_ref.quote: Such materials are called polaroids which have high directionality in crystal structure.

blocks.prompt:
42 Why is an analyzer used after a polarizer?
(Polarizer ke baad analyzer kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Analyzer doosra polarizer hai. Polarizer ke lihaaz se is ka angle badal kar polarized light ki intensity mazeed kam aur adjust ki ja sakti hai, kyunke I = I₀cos²θ.

book_ref.quote: It is used to further reduce the intensity of light and also adjust it

blocks.prompt:
43 Why does only the component A₀cos θ of polarized light pass through an analyzer?
(Polarized light ka sirf A₀cos θ component analyzer se kyun guzarta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Analyzer par θ angle par parne wala amplitude A₀ do hisson mein batt jata hai: A₀cos θ analyzer ke axis ke saath aur A₀sin θ us ke amoodan. Amoodi hissa A₀sin θ jazb ho jata hai, is liye A = A₀cos θ.

book_ref.quote: it is resolved into two components A₀cosθ and A₀sinθ

blocks.prompt:
44 What are the two extreme conditions of Malus's law?
(Malus's law ki do intehai halatein kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Agar θ = 0° ho to I = I₀: analyzer par parne wali saari polarized light guzarti hai. Agar θ = 90° ho to I = 0: light poori tarah bujh jati hai.

book_ref.quote: There are two extreme conditions of θ followed by the above equation given as,

blocks.prompt:
45 At what angle between polarizer and analyzer will the transmitted intensity be 40% of I₀?
(Polarizer aur analyzer ke darmiyan kis angle par guzarne wali intensity I₀ ka 40% hogi?)

book_ref.quote: Rotation of the analyzer affects the intensity of the polarized light.

blocks.prompt:
46 If the amplitude of polarized light after an analyzer is reduced to 0.8 of its incident value, what fraction of the intensity is transmitted?
(Agar analyzer ke baad polarized light ka amplitude apni asal qeemat ka 0.8 reh jaye to intensity ka kitna hissa guzrega?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke I = A², I/I₀ = (A/A₀)² = (0.8)² = 0.64, yani intensity ka 64% guzarta hai.

book_ref.quote: Since intensity I is the square of the amplitude A it can be expressed as:

blocks.prompt:
47 What are gravitational waves?
(Gravitational waves kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gravitational waves spacetime ke kapre mein lehrein (ripples) hain jo takrate black holes ya neutron stars jaise shadeed kaainati waqiaat se banti hain, light ki speed se chalti hain aur apne source ki maloomat le jati hain. GW space ka khinchna aur dabna hai.

book_ref.quote: A gravitational wave is a stretching and compressing of space

blocks.prompt:
48 Explain gravitational waves with the help of the pond analogy.
(Talaab ki misaal se gravitational waves ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Talaab mein phenka pathar paani ki satah par lehrein banata hai. Paani ki satah spacetime, pathar kaainati waqia, aur lehrein bahar ki taraf us ki maloomat le kar chalti hain; kinare par, yani GW observatories mein, pakri jati hain.

book_ref.quote: These ripples travel outward, carrying information about the stone

blocks.prompt:
49 Name the four basic types of gravitational waves.
(Gravitational waves ki chaar bunyadi qismon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Continuous GWs. (2) Compact binary inspiral GWs. (3) Burst GWs. (4) Stochastic GWs.

book_ref.quote: There are four basic types of gravitational waves

blocks.prompt:
50 Differentiate between continuous and burst gravitational waves.
(Continuous aur burst gravitational waves mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Continuous GWs yaksaan ghoomte ajsaam se; burst GWs achanak shadeed waqiaat se.

book_ref.quote: continuous GWs are produced with the same frequency and amplitude

rows: Aik bhaari jism (maslan neutron star) yaksaan raftaar se ghoome to banti hain.
Supernovae, gamma-ray bursts ya cosmic strings jaise shadeed waqiaat se banti hain.
Aik jaisi frequency aur amplitude.
Shadeed waqiye se achanak mukhtasar signals.
White dwarf binary systems bhi banate hain.
Source aik achanak waqia hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
51 What are stochastic gravitational waves? Why are they hard to detect?
(Stochastic gravitational waves kya hain? Inhein pakarna mushkil kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stochastic GWs bohat se kamzor sources, maslan door ke binary systems, ki superposition (milaap) se bane kamzor aur be-tarteeb signals hain. Kamzor aur random hone ki wajah se inhein pakarna sab se mushkil hai.

book_ref.quote: Stochastic GWs are weak, random signals of GWs

blocks.prompt:
52 Vehicles and airplanes accelerate. Why can't we detect gravitational waves from them?
(Gaariyan aur hawai jahaz accelerate karte hain. Un ki gravitational waves kyun nahi pakri ja saktin?)
blocks.explanation: Har accelerate karne wala jism GWs paida karta hai, magar Zameen par ajsaam ke mass aur acceleration itne chhote hain ke lehrein hamare aalaat se pakarne ke qabil nahi hotin.

book_ref.quote: The masses and acceleration of objects on the Earth are too small

blocks.prompt:
53 What information do gravitational waves from a binary system carry?
(Binary system ki gravitational waves kya maloomat le kar aati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh system ke mass, spin aur merger (milaap) ki harkiyat ki maloomat le kar aati hain, jo in intehai kaainati ajsaam ko samajhne mein madad deti hai. Yeh light ki speed se chalti hain.

book_ref.quote: The waves carry information about the system's mass, spin, and merger dynamics

blocks.prompt:
54 What is eccentricity of an orbit? What orbit has ε = 0 and what has 0 < ε < 1?
(Orbit ki eccentricity kya hai? ε = 0 aur 0 < ε < 1 wale orbits kaise hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Eccentricity ε batati hai ke orbit mukammal daaire se kitna hata hua hai. ε = 0 circular orbit; 0 < ε < 1 elliptical orbit (ε = 1 parabolic, ε > 1 hyperbolic).

book_ref.quote: Eccentricity ε is a measure of the amount by which an object deviates from a perfect circle.

blocks.prompt:
55 How does Einstein's general theory of relativity describe gravity?
(Einstein ka general theory of relativity gravity ko kaise bayan karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gravity force nahi balke bhaari ajsaam se spacetime ka kham (curvature) hai. Gadde mein gurhe ki tarah bhaari cheezein apne gird space ko mor deti hain, isi liye hum gravity mehsoos karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Gravity is like a dent in a mattress.

blocks.prompt:
56 What is a binary system in the context of gravitational waves?
(Gravitational waves ke hawale se binary system kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do compact ajsaam, maslan black holes, neutron stars ya white dwarfs, ka system jo aik doosre ke gird ghoom kar gravitational waves kharij karte hain.

book_ref.quote: A Binary System (BS) in the context of gravitational waves refers to

blocks.prompt:
57 What are tidal forces due to gravitational waves?
(Gravitational waves ki wajah se tidal forces kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jism se guzarti GW us ke gird spacetime ko hilati hai, is liye jism lehar ki simt ke amoodan baar baar khinchta aur dabta hai. Is spacetime distortion ko tidal forces kehte hain, jaise Chaand aur Sooraj se tides.

book_ref.quote: Gravitational waves passing through a body with mass can cause the body to experience periodic stretching

blocks.prompt:
58 On what does the amount of stretching and compressing of a body by a gravitational wave depend?
(Gravitational wave se jism ke khinchne aur dabne ki miqdaar kin baaton par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh gravitational wave ki taaqat aur jism ke mass aur size par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: The amount of stretching and compressing depends on the strength of the gravitational wave

blocks.prompt:
59 Why are extremely sensitive instruments needed to detect gravitational waves at the Earth?
(Zameen par gravitational waves pakarne ke liye intehai hassas aalaat kyun chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Zameen tak pohanchne wali GWs ka amplitude intehai chhota hai, taqreeban 10⁻²¹ se 10⁻²² ka strain (ΔL/L). LIGO ke 4 km arms ki lambai is se sirf taqreeban 10⁻¹⁸ m badalti hai.

book_ref.quote: requires extremely sensitive instruments to detect

blocks.prompt:
